title: Combate · natureza
prompt: Create a crisp detailed pixel-art sprite animation sheet for Agents Bar, matching silver-blue, warm gold, deep navy medieval fantasy materials. TRUE frame-by-frame shapes changing, no merely translated or recolored copies. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, one animation per row, four successive frames left to right. Transparent alpha-zero background. No text, no labels, no frames, no checkerboard. Each cell has 15% empty padding on every edge; keep the whole effect inside its cell, with constant scale. No characters. Row1 healing: green sprouts curl upward, luminous leaves unfurl, golden pollen ring expands, leaves fall. Row2 leaf strike: curled pair of leaves, slicing fan of five leaves, leaf spiral expands, scattered leaves. Row3 spores: small pale green puff, puff expands with round motes, irregular drifting cloud, faint separated motes. Row4 shield: tiny golden-blue sigil, rising oval energy shield, ripple over shield, shield breaks into small blue shards.
